notes:
Context: Omniflare is a mid-market SaaS vendor that provides an in-app knowledge base and contextual support assistant for 100+ enterprise customers. They are evaluating hosted API for production RAG with an embeddings + reranking pipeline.

Key constraints (shorthand):
- Indexing scale: ~800k docs (user manuals, KB articles, changelogs) -> ~3.2B tokens; daily delta ~5k docs.
- QPS target: 150 sustained QPS; 400 QPS burst during support peaks.
- Latency SLO: customer goal is end-to-end p95 <120ms for a reranked answer (embedding lookup + rerank). CTO quote: "If rerank pushes us over 200ms we lose it".
- Cost target: high sensitivity — want average cost < $0.01 per query (embeddings + retrieval + rerank amortized).
- Preferred models: open, quantized embedding model 1536d; small instruction-tuned reranker (~7B) or distilled policy; willing to test Redwood-verified model variants.
- Routing: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU fallback) and automatic fallback to embed-only cheaper flow under heavy load.

Recent timeline (bullets / CRM-style):
- 2025-11-15: Lead created from webinar (Jordan M).
- 2025-12-02: Intro discovery call — discussed architecture, data residency; follow-up ask for scale numbers (Priya).
- 2026-01-20: Tech deep-dive with infra team; shared sample dataset (20k docs), agreed POC scope.
- 2026-02-02: Product demo (Fireflies ff-20260202-omniflare-poc-demo).
- 2026-02-15: Security kickoff — provided security FAQ and SSO requirements (drive.redwood/security/omniflare-security-reqs).
- 2026-03-01: Cost/throughput review with engineering; Redwood ran internal cost sim for 150 QPS. Meeting recorded (ff-20260301-omniflare-security-call).
- 2026-03-05: POC started — ingest pipeline + FAISS HNSW index; initial embedding throughput tests.
- 2026-03-09: Last sync: rerank latency p95 observed ~140ms in NA region (needs improvement).

POC acceptance criteria (customer-facing):
- Embedding pipeline throughput >= 8k embeddings/sec for batch path.
- Retrieval + rerank p95 < 120ms at 150 QPS in NA.
- Cost per successful query <= $0.01.
- Region-aware routing validated (NA/EU).

What they like about Redwood so far:
- Transparent perf/cost sims and observability; clear knobs for batching/kv-caching.
- Model catalog with verified perf profiles (helpful for cost modeling).

Open risks and asks:
- EU data residency: customer has several EU-headquartered customers; asks if private deployment or regional hosted endpoints required.
- Legal: NDA + standard DPA to be returned.
- Price: need a committed burst plan or credits for sustained high-QPS to hit target ARR math.

Quotes / paraphrases: "We need reranking without doubling our bill" — Head of Product. "Can you show p95 with 200 QPS? We need numbers not slides" — Lead SWE.

Next steps (again): legal NDA, Redwood to run EU region throughput test (deadline 2026-03-20), finalize pricing for committed monthly bursts.
